data.name: Shashikumar
data.gender_notes: Shashikumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Shashi means peace, and Kumar means young boy or prince. So Shashikumar means a young prince or king who brings peace. The name Shashikumar carries the meaning “King of Peace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Shashikumar usually hope their child will grow to embody king of peace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes inner peace and tranquility, as well as a strong and powerful leader.
data.etymology: Shashikumar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “King of Peace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shashikumar total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shashikumar carries a rich cultural legacy in Hinduism. The name evokes the image of a young, powerful, and peaceful ruler. It is a tribute to the complex and enduring tradition of Hindu royalty, where power and peace co-existed. Furthermore, the name has been popular in Hindu literature, including ancient Sanskrit texts and contemporary Indian literature.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper spiritual level, Shashikumar resonates with the Hindu concept of inner peace and the divine ruler within. The name is a reminder of the inner peace and power that each individual holds within, as well as the potential to be a peaceful and benevolent force in the world. It also represents the ideal of a spiritual leader who uses their power for the welfare of their people. The name Shashikumar thus embodies the noble qualities of peace, power, and rulership, inspiring individuals to strive towards inner peace and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Shashikumar signifies the one who embodies wisdom and righteousness. The name is a combination of 'Shashi' meaning wisdom and 'Kumar' signifying a youth or student. It represents an individual constantly seeking knowledge and living a virtuous life.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Shashikumar was a renowned king in the Chalukya dynasty during the 11th century. The name Shashikumar carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Shashikumar is of Indian origin and is composed of two Sanskrit words: Shashi (meaning tranquility or calmness) and Kumar (meaning young prince or youth). It is a popular name in India and is used as a personal name for both males and females. In modern usage, the name can be found on various platforms such as social media and genealogy websites.
